description: Synthetic regression fixture: original v1 schema and one test registration, captured before the v2 build. No process or user session was executed; host paths and generated job IDs are replaced.

schema.name: job_events
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE job_events(job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(job_id),sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot_json)),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(job_id,sequence)) STRICT

schema.name: jobs
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE jobs(job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,controller_id TEXT NOT NULL,operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,request_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(request_json)),execution_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(execution_json)),owner_key TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('QUEUED','STARTING','RUNNING','STOPPING','EXITED','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN')),container_id TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,started_at TEXT,ended_at TEXT,exit_code INTEGER,stop_requested INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stop_requested IN (0,1)),stop_evidence TEXT CHECK(stop_evidence IS NULL OR json_valid(stop_evidence)),error_code TEXT,lease_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(lease_sequence>=0),lease_hash TEXT NOT NULL,lease_permit_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(lease_permit_json)),lease_renewed_at TEXT NOT NULL,log_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,outputs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(outputs_json)),UNIQUE(controller_id,operation_id),CHECK(state='EXITED' OR exit_code IS NULL)) STRICT

schema.name: runner_identity
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE runner_identity(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),runner_id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1)) STRICT

schema.name: immutable_job_identity
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_job_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON jobs WHEN NEW.job_id<>OLD.job_id OR NEW.controller_id<>OLD.controller_id OR NEW.operation_id<>OLD.operation_id OR NEW.request_hash<>OLD.request_hash OR NEW.request_json<>OLD.request_json OR NEW.execution_json<>OLD.execution_json OR NEW.owner_key<>OLD.owner_key BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'JOB_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE'); END

schema.name: immutable_job_terminal
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_job_terminal BEFORE UPDATE ON jobs WHEN OLD.state='EXITED' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'JOB_TERMINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END
